description.value:
Duration constant

The Graft knows what to do without you. You have said it enough times.

When you apply a healing Graft to a creature, you may set one condition on it: the next time that creature is reduced below half its Hit Points before your next daily preparations, the Graft’s effect triggers again at half value, without any action from you. Only one creature may carry a Standing Order at a time.
